faq.question: Q1. What posts are available in AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Mangalagiri is recruiting for the posts of Research Scientist (B) (Medical) and Multi-Tasking Staff. These positions are offered on a contractual basis under an ICMR project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the email application for the AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026 is 28 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced in the AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026. This includes one position for Research Scientist (B) (Medical) and one for Multi-Tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Research Scientist (B) (Medical) and Multi-Tasking Staff posts at AIIMS Mangalagiri is via email. Candidates need to send their updated CV and documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications for Research Scientist (B) (Medical)?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Research Scientist (B) (Medical) post must possess an MBBS degree recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI). Preference will be given to those with lab experience in Virology Research.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification for Multi-Tasking Staff?
faq.answer: For the Multi-Tasking Staff position, candidates must have completed High School or an equivalent qualification from a recognized board. No specific experience is mentioned for this role.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Research Scientist (B) (Medical)?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Scientist (B) (Medical) post is 35 years. Upper age relaxation is applicable as per the rules of the Government of India for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Multi-Tasking Staff?
faq.answer: The Multi-Tasking Staff selected for AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026 will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 18,000 per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of AIIMS Mangalagiri?
faq.answer: The official website for All India Institute of Medical Sciences Mangalagiri is www.aiimsmangalagiri.edu.in. Candidates can visit this website for more details and official updates regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026 includes written tests (if applicable) and an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and performance in these stages.
